sheets.name: Exceptions
rows: Automatically flagged by the VAT engine in the Register (column R)
• Invalid TRN: obtain valid supplier TRN / tax invoice before claiming input VAT; hold payment until resolved.
• Blocked input: confirm entertainment-type spend is coded to non-recoverable GL; review policy for client events.
• Late posting: tighten month-end cut-off so tax points fall in the correct VAT return period (penalty exposure).
